mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEST.LOGIN_USER ( USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NM, EMAIL, PHONE, DEL_YN, REG_DT, UPD_DT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userNm}, #{email}, #{phone}, 'N', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PW AS userPw, USER_NM AS userNm, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, DEL_YN AS del_yn, TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt, TO_CHAR(UPD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updDt FROM TEST.LOGIN_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PW AS userPw, USER_NM AS userNm, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, DEL_YN AS delYn, TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt, TO_CHAR(UPD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updDt FROM TEST.LOGIN_USER WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TEST.LOGIN_USER SET USER_PW = #{userPw}, USER_NM = #{userNm}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TEST.LOGIN_USER SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
